common_prompt:
Create one polished, original, high-end game character concept sheet for the variant described below. Setting: 2043, a realistic dark near future. The adult human protagonist belongs to MERIDIAN, a secret government unit of trained parautilitarians. Time slowdown, force push and telekinesis are personal abilities; do not illustrate powers, their origin or any machine that supplies them. Every outfit detail is a design proposal, not an established uniform, biography or rank. Design an original person and equipment, without borrowing a recognizable franchise character, costume, logo or signature mask.

Use a clean landscape sheet, approximately 3:2. One dominant full-body three-quarter FRONT view occupies the left half and most of the height. A smaller full-body three-quarter REAR view occupies the center-right; two compact detail insets at far right show the closed worn mask and a worn glove with its sleeve cuff. Both full-body views include the complete head and both boot soles with comfortable margins. The rear view depicts exactly the same outfit, construction, proportions and equipment as the main view. Left and right always mean the wearer's sides; do not mirror asymmetric parts. Insets are close-ups of the same worn components, not additional designs. Keep all views separate and uncropped except for the deliberate insets. Restrained English header: MERIDIAN / 2043. Add the variant number and name exactly as supplied below. No other main text, emblems, logos, badges or approval stamps.

Realistic human anatomy and scale, natural limb lengths, a capable ordinary human build, clear five-finger full gloves and practical flexible-soled boots. Relaxed upright stance with arms slightly away from the torso and both hands EMPTY; no weapons anywhere on the sheet, no holsters, no slung rifle, no combat pose. No bare skin anywhere: conceal face, eyes, hair, ears, neck, wrists and fingers in every view and inset. Lenses are dark and externally opaque, non-emissive optical eye protection; never reveal eyes through them. Include a plausible viewing zone, never a blind solid faceplate or exposed eye holes. Keep the mask closed; no face-shaped sculpted nose, lips, teeth or skull motifs.

Believable sewn and assembled 2043 equipment. Clear stock seating area, shallow cheek equipment, flexible shoulders, underarms, elbows, knees and wrists; no oversize armor, exoskeleton, powered gauntlets, gadgets without a clear purpose, hanging cables, long loose straps or excessive pouches. Use the specified limited ordinary equipment. No glassy science-fiction suit, magic ornament, neon or camouflage copied from an existing uniform.

Paint readable cloth weave, seams, rubber, leather and restrained composite surfaces with purposeful painterly edges and controlled detail. Neutral warm-gray background, gentle ground contact shadow, soft directional studio lighting and clear separation of dark material values; not a black-on-black silhouette, glossy 3D render, photograph or comic. Light practical edge wear only, no wounds or story-specific catastrophe damage. Follow the variant's large shapes before adding small details.

variants.name: Cutline
variants.design_summary: Compact exposed plate vest, clipped-edge helmet and shallow hard mask; fitted sleeves and tapered legs create a precise, compact silhouette.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 01 / Cutline. Build the outfit around short, clipped-corner protective shapes and clean gaps at moving joints. A compact waist-length vest holds one flattened dark composite chest plate with clipped lower corners and a corresponding smaller back plate. Soft ash-gray fabric wraps the ribs; a narrow gap between vest hem and belt exposes only a covered stretch midlayer. Graphite sleeves are fitted without looking skintight. Tapered articulated trousers have modest fabric knee pads and practical low-profile mid-height boots. Two flat closed equipment cells sit at the side waist; leave the front belt and upper chest uncluttered.

The head uses a low helmet with a subtly flattened crown and clipped brow corners, without accessory rails. A single broad, black, externally opaque viewing lens wraps the eyes. Below it, a shallow charcoal composite mask hides nose, cheeks and jaw, meeting a continuous fabric neck liner. Its simple diagonal cheek seams repeat the plate corners without creating a robot face. No filter canisters or lamps.

Rear view: show the smaller clipped-corner back plate, fabric shoulder connections, clean covered lower back and the same lateral cells. Mask inset shows the lens-to-shell junction. Glove inset shows separate flexible knuckle pads and one clipped-corner cuff reinforcement; fingers and palm remain thin and mobile. Graphite and ash dominate, with a small dull-olive fabric waist panel. Keep the silhouette compact and the shoulder line entirely human.

variants.name: Fold
variants.design_summary: Helmetless cowl and diagonally wrapped smock over concealed protection; pleated cloth mask and soft gathered volume define the design.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 02 / Fold. Design a textile-led outfit with a deep fitted cowl and a diagonal wrap smock, broader through the chest and gathered close at the waist. The overlapping front closes from the wearer's left collar to right lower ribs. Broad woven folds form a readable diagonal rhythm, not loose rags. Small concealed torso inserts give slight structure without exposed hard plates. The short smock hem ends at the high hip; loose upper trouser legs narrow toward reinforced knees and flexible ankle boots. Two low-profile closed pouches sit at the side-back waist.

No rigid helmet. A shaped hood surrounds two separated rounded-rectangle goggle lenses, both completely black and externally opaque. A supported, pleated textile cover encloses the entire lower face and joins the neck liner. The outer folds obscure facial anatomy; no eye holes, skin gaps or visible facial contours. Keep the cheek width shallow and the hood securely fitted for movement.

Rear view: a broad diagonal overlap crosses the upper back and ends in a small flat waist fastening; the hood has a center seam and no long tail. The mask inset clarifies the two lenses seated within the cowl and the closed layered lower cover. Glove inset: soft dark leather full-finger glove, diagonal fabric cuff overlapping the sleeve, no rigid knuckle shell. Use smoke-brown woven cloth, peat-gray reinforcement and charcoal leather, with varied textile roughness rather than color accents.

variants.name: Long Panel
variants.design_summary: Narrow mid-thigh technical coat with four moving hem panels, hidden torso protection and a tall oval mask under a fitted head liner.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 03 / Long Panel. Create a restrained long vertical silhouette through a mid-thigh technical coat in blue charcoal. The coat is fitted through the ribs, with concealed thin chest and back inserts and completely unpadded shoulders. Walking vents begin at the high hip and divide the lower coat into four short panels that separate naturally over the legs; the hem stays well above the knees. Use a covered central closure, two long recessed hip pockets and a narrow internal waist adjustment. Keep lower legs visible in straight articulated trousers and plain lace-up mid-height boots. No external chest rig, trailing coat tails or oversized collar.

The head has a close continuous dark fabric liner and a tall, narrow oval mask that covers the entire face. A single horizontal, softly curved black viewing lens sits in the upper portion. A shallow molded lower shell continues toward the chin without a sculpted human nose or mouth. The coat's unused hood is folded flat behind the neck, leaving the mask silhouette legible. All joins are closed and opaque.

Rear view: show the flat stowed hood, concealed back insert, small waist adjustment and matching four-panel vent structure. Mask inset emphasizes the oval perimeter and one viewing lens. Glove inset shows matte leather fingers, a long sleeve vent closed by one narrow wrist tab and a subtle vertical seam. Weathered gray edge reinforcement repeats the long lines. Keep everything plausible for stairs and crouching.

variants.name: Webbing
variants.design_summary: Roomy utility coverall with a narrow strap harness, compact suspended protection and broad waist load carriage; the structure stays visibly textile.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 04 / Webbing. A practical shale-gray utility coverall forms a continuous torso-and-leg garment with generous movement folds at the elbows and knees. Over it, a narrow dusty-khaki webbing harness suspends a small fabric-covered chest insert and matching upper-back insert. Two vertical straps and short horizontal keepers form a simple open rectangular structure; large areas of the coverall remain visible. This is soft load-bearing webbing, never a metal frame or exoskeleton. A broad padded waist belt carries two closed lateral magazine-size cells and one small side-back utility pouch. Nothing hangs below the upper hip. Trousers are straight and gathered neatly above flexible black work-combat boots.

A low rounded helmet has no projecting attachments. Two separate black trapezoid viewing lenses sit within a continuous dark face surround. A flat textile-covered jaw cup closes the lower face and meets the neck liner, with attachment tabs tucked beside the ears. No exposed ears or gap below the goggles.

Rear view: show the two straps joining a small rectangular back insert, short belt attachment loops and a clean centerline without a backpack. Mask detail reveals lens borders and the covered jaw connection. Glove detail shows thin black grip leather, one narrow webbing wrist tab and the ordinary coverall cuff. Preserve the contrast between taut narrow straps and relaxed cloth; avoid a large conventional plate carrier.

variants.name: Channel
variants.design_summary: High-collar, boxy quilted gilet over narrow ribbed sleeves; horizontal padded channels concentrate the mass around the torso.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 05 / Channel. Give the protagonist a boxy sleeveless protective gilet reaching the high hip, worn over close rib-knit sleeves. Three broad, restrained horizontal quilted channels cross the front and continue coherently around the sides and back. The gilet has a straight hem and a padded stand collar, creating a compact rectangular torso above slimmer legs. It is dense protective textile, not a huge down jacket. Internal protection remains covered; no exposed composite plates. Leave the shoulder joint and underarm flexible. Two shallow closed equipment pockets are built into the lowest front-side channel. Slim charcoal trousers have small fabric knee reinforcements, with compact flexible boots.

The head uses a close soft padded skullcap, without a rigid helmet. One broad flush black goggle lens conceals the eyes. A separate smooth charcoal lower mask covers the entire face below it, its edges disappearing into the continuous neck shroud inside the padded collar. The collar stays below the jaw and does not lock head movement. No skin gaps.

Rear view: show the uninterrupted quilted channel rhythm and a simple center seam without a backpack. The mask inset clarifies the relationship between skullcap, goggles and lower mask. The glove inset shows a long close glove cuff overlapping the ribbed sleeve, narrow soft finger pads and a flexible wrist. Coal fabric and muted plum-gray quilting differ mainly in value and texture. Let horizontal torso volume versus narrow vertical limbs be the defining read.

variants.name: Rain Yoke
variants.design_summary: Hip-length shell with a short chest-and-back storm overlayer, shaped hood and calf gaiters; broad rain-shedding forms dominate.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 06 / Rain Yoke. Build a practical layered rain-shell silhouette around a short storm yoke: a broad, softly curved overlayer across the upper chest and upper back, ending just below the shoulder blades. It is sewn into a hip-length shell and secured at its lower side corners, with open arm exits. It must not become a long cape, poncho or hanging shoulder curtain. The underlying sleeves articulate freely. Thin protection sits inside the shell. Two flat side-waist equipment pockets remain accessible below the overlayer; the center chest is clear. Straight trousers enter short calf gaiters over flexible dark boots.

A close structured hood continues the shell's broad curved geometry. One broad black lens follows the brow and wraps shallowly toward the temples. A rubberized lower-face baffle conceals nose, mouth and chin, joining a continuous dark neck liner. Avoid protruding breathing hoses and filter cans; the face system stays shallow.

Rear view: show the overlayer's broad arch, secured corners, slight drainage gap above the lower jacket and both gaiter closures. Mask detail shows the hood lip and sealed lens border; no face visible inside. Glove detail shows a double storm cuff covering the sleeve/glove join, pebbled grip palms and supple full fingers. Use slate-green shell fabric, charcoal rubber and muted stone reinforcement. Emphasize thin laminated cloth with a few broad folds, not glossy plastic or heavy armor.

variants.name: Bib
variants.design_summary: Reinforced workwear bib and broad suspenders over flexible sleeves, with straight durable legs and a compact cap-shell mask system.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 07 / Bib. Interpret durable workwear as original tactical clothing. A square, reinforced bib rises from straight iron-brown trousers to the upper chest. Two broad suspenders support it over a black flexible long-sleeved underlayer. A thin chest insert is concealed inside the bib; the square outline is visible through stitching, not an exposed plate. Two closed flat equipment cells sit at the outside hip seams, with no hanging tools. Knees use broad woven reinforcement and a small articulation dart. The ankles enter practical dark leather boots with modest protective toes. Keep the silhouette sturdy, mobile and human rather than industrial power armor.

The head combines a close short-brim protective cap shell with an independent enclosed face unit. The brim stays very short. Two square black optical lenses are set into a rounded rubber surround; a shallow molded lower mask encloses the cheeks, nose and chin. A continuous cloth liner closes the head and neck. No bare ears or throat, no large canisters.

Rear view: crossed broad suspenders anchor to a small flat upper-back insert and the reinforced trouser waist; clearly show the garment's bib construction. Mask detail emphasizes square lenses within soft rounded borders. Glove detail shows a long leather cuff overlapping the sleeve, one broad rectangular reinforcement seam and flexible separate fingers. Small faded-clay stitching panels support the iron-brown, black and worn-leather palette. Use ordinary fabric engineering and purposeful closures.

variants.name: Overlap
variants.design_summary: Asymmetric carrier closure, left rib and high-hip padding, and right-side load carriage; overlapping shapes repeat in the closed mask and cuffs.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 08 / Overlap. Compose an asymmetrical but balanced outfit around an offset short protective carrier over a fitted desaturated-green jacket. The actual chest and back protection stays centered on the body; the carrier opens diagonally toward the wearer's right side. A broader soft pad covers the left ribs and continues as one short flexible high-hip panel. The right hip stays clear except for two shallow closed equipment cells on the side-back belt. Keep both shoulders slim and leave the stock seating area unobstructed. Straight basalt trousers have modest articulated fabric knees and compact lace-up boots. No excessive straps.

Use a close, subtly faceted helmet without accessories. A continuous black angled eye band provides the viewing lens. Below it, two shallow overlapping shell pieces cover the lower face, one sweeping from the left cheek toward the right jaw. A fabric neck liner closes all edges. The overlaps are functional cover seams, not a robotic mouth or beak; cheeks stay low profile.

Rear view must preserve the left-side padded extension and right-side pouches without mirroring them. Show a centered small back plate and an offset fabric closing flap. Mask detail makes the overlap order readable. Glove detail repeats the design through an offset cuff fastening and two small flexible dorsal leather patches, with no hard power gauntlet. Basalt, desaturated green and dark rubber create restrained material contrast. Asymmetry must remain readable at silhouette scale.

variants.name: Edge Guards
variants.design_summary: Slim soft torso with restrained tapered abrasion guards on outer forearms and shins; protection at the limbs gives the outfit its distinct structure.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 09 / Edge Guards. Keep the torso unusually quiet: a fitted cement-gray zip jacket over concealed thin chest/back protection, without an external carrier. Give the outer forearms and front-outer shins small tapered matte composite abrasion guards. These are human-scale protective pieces, not armor tubes; inner forearms, wrists, elbows, ankles and knee bends remain fabric. The guards stop well short of each joint and use short covered attachment tabs. Charcoal trousers retain natural knee folds. A light side belt carries two flat closed utility cells, and flexible boots have brown rubber toe and sole edges.

The head has a close smooth fabric cowl with no separate helmet. A single horizontally oval black viewing lens sits in a shallow surrounding frame. A restrained wraparound jaw guard closes the lower face and blends into the cloth neck cover. The mask has no human facial relief, lamps or electronic display. Keep a usable cheek profile.

Rear view: show the smooth jacket back, covered guard attachments on the outside limbs and plain fabric calves between shin pieces and boots. Mask detail highlights the oval lens seated in the cowl. Glove detail shows the outer forearm guard ending above a soft sleeve-to-glove overlap; the hand itself uses thin leather and separate fingers. The long tapered protective edges should guide the design, without suggesting devices for telekinesis or any powered function.

variants.name: Knit
variants.design_summary: Helmetless, textile-dominant outfit with a close rib-knit upper body, rounded soft protection and roomy tapered cargo legs; almost no exposed hard components.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 10 / Knit. Design a fully covered textile-dominant outfit with a close but naturally draped faded-navy technical-knit upper body. Fine rib directions change at the shoulder and elbow to show movement construction. Rounded covered protection zones sit at the ribs and upper back without revealing muscle anatomy or separate hard plates. The torso narrows to a simple soft waistband. Roomier warm-gray cargo trousers provide a contrasting leg silhouette: curved high-side cargo cells, broad upper-thigh folds, articulated knees and tapered ankles inside flexible ankle boots. Keep storage compact and the front waist clear.

No helmet. A close stretch head cover holds two separate compact black goggle lenses with rounded edges. A shaped textile mouth-and-nose cover, supported away from the face internally, joins the neck cover and obscures all facial features. The system remains fitted, fully closed and externally opaque. No ninja eye slit, blindfold or visible skin.

Rear view: show rounded upper-back textile padding, continuous knit sleeve transitions and the same curved cargo pocket placement. The mask detail focuses on covered goggle borders and lower-cover attachment. Glove detail shows a nearly seamless soft full-finger glove with a narrow grip-leather palm and a long knit-to-cuff overlap. Use black closures sparingly. Differentiate the soft knit, dense reinforcement weave and lightly worn rubber; avoid a shiny superhero bodysuit or exposed musculature.

variants.name: Blouson
variants.design_summary: Cropped roomy utility blouson above a low load belt; gathered sleeves and broad trouser thighs create a compact, rounded silhouette.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 11 / Blouson. Make a cropped utility blouson the dominant garment. Its soot-gray woven body and upper sleeves have controlled rounded volume; the hem gathers just above the natural waist and the sleeves narrow into snug cuffs. Thin torso protection sits under the jacket. A low, broad load belt is visible below the hem with two flat closed side cells and one small back-side pouch. The front waist remains clear. Broad trouser thighs taper through articulated knees into sturdy but flexible boots. A tiny muted-ocher lining edge appears only at the closed collar seam, not as a bright stripe or insignia.

A low rounded helmet has a modest shallow brow visor and a completely black viewing lens below it. A padded squared lower-face cover encloses cheeks, nose and jaw and meets a continuous cloth neck liner. Keep the head compact, with no accessories, projecting beak or visible facial contours.

Rear view: show the gathered blouson hem above the belt, broad upper-back cloth, a simple shoulder seam and matching pouch placement. Mask detail shows the shallow visor and softly squared lower cover. Glove detail emphasizes the contrast between the gathered woven sleeve and short matte leather glove, with a broad thumb reinforcement and flexible finger joints. The cuffs overlap fully. The outfit should feel substantial through garment volume, not oversized armor, inflated padding or exaggerated human anatomy.

variants.name: Split Vest
variants.design_summary: Long sleeveless woven protective vest with four separated upper-thigh panels over narrow sleeves; vertical textile slabs form a distinctive open-sided silhouette.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 12 / Split Vest. Use a long sleeveless dense-woven protective vest over a close dark long-sleeved underlayer. Its upper chest and back contain flat hidden inserts. Below the high hip, the vest separates into four short panels, two front and two back, ending at the upper thigh. High side openings and a center split allow full leg movement. The panels are soft, relatively straight textile pieces with weighted hems, never a robe, skirt or rigid armor apron. Narrow sleeves remain visible from the shoulder joint down. One shallow closed pouch is recessed into each rear-side panel near its upper attachment, leaving the front clean. Straight narrow trousers and simple mid-height boots keep the body readable.

A compact flat-topped soft protective cap sits over a fully enclosed head liner. Wide rectangular black goggles and a planar fabric-faced lower mask close the entire face. The lower mask has simple shallow planes and no facial sculpture. A flat neck shroud tucks into the underlayer; no bare skin.

Rear view: show the two back panels, the center split, upper-back insert outline and recessed side equipment. Mask detail clarifies the flat cap, rectangular lens and cloth-faced lower cover. Glove detail shows a flat woven sleeve with two narrow transverse wrist tabs over a flexible dark full-finger glove. Warm-gray vest fabric, charcoal sleeves and dark-taupe reinforcements distinguish long woven planes from soft joints.

variants.name: Seam Seal
variants.design_summary: Continuous sealed-seam coverall with recessed equipment, integrated hood and broad opaque lens; clean joined surfaces replace exposed straps and plates.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 13 / Seam Seal. Create a one-piece mineral-gray technical coverall with continuous, readable joined seams and a fitted integrated hood. The suit has believable breathing room and movement folds; it is neither skin-tight nor a swollen hazardous-material suit. A flat chest/back carrier is worn beneath it, visible only as subtle structured volume. Recessed closed pockets at the side waist carry the limited equipment without an external belt rig. Soft knee and seat reinforcement use dark teal-gray panels. Sealed ankle cuffs overlap practical black flexible boots. No tank, hoses, external cables, status lights or printed hazard symbols.

The hood has a flexible dark gasket around one broad black face lens, externally opaque and curved shallowly across the upper face. Below the lens, a low fabric-covered chin filter pocket and smooth opaque lower-face panel completely conceal facial anatomy. The head assembly is close fitting and can plausibly turn; do not add a rigid neck ring. This is ordinary protective clothing, with no anomaly-control function.

Rear view: show a simple central upper-back seam branching around the shoulder movement zones, flat covered protection and the clean pocket layout. Mask detail shows soft gasket, lens and low chin pocket. Glove detail shows overlapping flexible gasket cuffs and smooth rubberized full-finger gloves with grippy palms. Use soft matte coated textile against dark rubber, modest welded seam highlights and minimal wear. The continuous outer garment is the defining construction.

variants.name: Field Tailor
variants.design_summary: Structured hip-length field jacket with flat diagonal lapels and concealed equipment; tailored textile planes contrast with a fully closed, minimal face system.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 14 / Field Tailor. Design a structured hip-length field jacket in ink-brown technical twill, with a clean natural shoulder line, flat restrained diagonal lapels and a closed offset front. This is mobile field clothing, not a suit with a tie or a dress uniform. A thin protective vest sits underneath. Articulated sleeves, short side vents and two recessed low cargo pockets reveal its practical construction. Straight charcoal trousers have discreet knee darts and end in plain flexible mid-height boots. No exposed tactical webbing, decorative buttons, rank marks, formal insignia or external hanging equipment.

A fitted dark fabric head liner covers the head and neck. A single narrow curved black viewing lens follows the brow within a slim frame. Smooth opaque textile-covered cheek and jaw panels close the entire lower face and tuck into the jacket collar. All facial anatomy and skin remain concealed; avoid sunglasses on an exposed face or a sculpted human mask. The cheek area stays shallow.

Rear view: show the simple central jacket seam, two short side vents, natural shoulder tailoring and slight covered back-protection volume. Mask detail emphasizes the lens frame and broad featureless cloth-faced lower panels. Glove detail shows an articulated sleeve with an angled cuff seam, a narrow concealed wrist closure and matte leather full-finger gloves. Pale seam-edge wear is the only light accent. Large quiet fabric planes and precise tailoring carry the identity.

variants.name: Hip Guard
variants.design_summary: Light upper body over a protective waist wrap and separate mobile hip panels; lower-torso protection and side-back storage shift the silhouette downward.
variants.prompt:
Variant label: 15 / Hip Guard. Give the design a light, uncluttered upper torso and a stronger protective waist silhouette. A warm-gray flexible long-sleeved top covers thin upper chest/back inserts without an exposed plate vest. Around the waist, a broad dark-olive protective textile wrap divides into separate short padded left and right hip panels. They end at the very top of the thighs and move independently. Leave the front groin and thigh creases free over fully covering trousers; no rigid skirt, hanging crotch armor or exaggerated pelvis. One shallow closed equipment cell sits behind each hip panel. Straight black articulated trousers and restrained olive-and-rubber boots continue the practical lower-body read.

The head uses a close padded fabric cover without a rigid helmet. Two black low-profile lens windows sit in a soft continuous surround above a compact enclosed chin cup. A smooth neck shroud joins the top. The chin cup and surrounding material hide all facial contours; no exposed mouth, eye holes or skin. Keep the eye and cheek assemblies shallow.

Rear view: show the waist wrap's rear adjustment, independent side panels, symmetrical side-back cells and an uncluttered fabric upper back. Mask detail reveals the padded surround and closed chin/neck overlap. Glove detail shows a woven glove back, a thin grip-leather palm, a flexible narrow cuff and a soft sleeve extending beyond the wrist joint. Use small chevron-shaped construction seams only at panel joins, never as logos or powered ornament.
